title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 8: Lion Rafale
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．８ 「リオン・ラファール」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 8 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Lion Rafale. Newly made computer graphics show him snowboarding, skateboarding through a park, carrying an armful of flowers and posing by a wrought-iron gate, in a sequence staged to his image song "Winner or Loser", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Lion Rafale
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
